type.description: The message name — <name> in the routing key.

domain.description: The owning domain — <domain> in the routing key. Names the role, not the vendor.

kind.description: Which exchange carries this message. Never reaches the routing key.

ts.description: The PUBLISH instant — when this message went out, ISO-8601 UTC. A republish has the same content and a new ts.

target.description: The switcher this message addresses — the <target> routing segment: the switcher's configured name, 'main' by default, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Required on every switcher message.

model.description: The model's name, as the switcher reports it.

id.description: The source: the switcher's source id, non-negative.

shortName.description: The source's short name, as the switcher reports it; may be empty. Which sources get a console key is the console's rule — a source with a short name.

longName.description: The source's long name, as the switcher reports it; may be empty.

items.description: One source the switcher reports: its id and its two names.

sources.description: Every source the switcher reports, each with its id and its two names.

superSource.description: The SuperSource, numbered from 1 — some models have two.

id.description: The SuperSource's own source id: the switcher's source id, non-negative.

source.description: The source in the box: the switcher's source id, non-negative.

items.description: One SuperSource box: its number, whether it is enabled, and its source.

boxes.description: The SuperSource's boxes, in box order.

fill.description: The art's fill source: the switcher's source id, non-negative.

key.description: The art's key source: the switcher's source id, non-negative.

placement.description: Where the art sits: background, behind the boxes, or foreground, over them.

art.description: A SuperSource's art: its fill and key sources, and its placement.

items.description: One SuperSource: its number, its source id, its boxes and its art.

superSources.description: Every SuperSource the switcher has, each with its boxes and its art.

SwitcherDetailsChanged.description: The switcher's advanced state — its model, every source it reports with both names, and its SuperSources' boxes and art. No link: the basic state carries it. The whole document, published when any of it changes.
